help.title: NemakiWare Help
help.imageHint: Click an image to enlarge it.

user.loginStep2Desc: Enter the username provided by your administrator
user.authConditional: Passkey, OIDC, and SAML buttons are only shown when the server has those authentication methods enabled. Contact your administrator if they are not visible.
user.authPasskeyDesc: Touch ID / Face ID / security key (requires HTTPS + server config)
user.authOIDCDesc: Google / Microsoft cloud authentication (requires server config)
user.documentsIntro: The main screen displayed after login.
user.leftPaneDesc: Click a folder to select it. Click the already-selected folder again to set it as the current folder.
user.mainAreaDesc: List of files and subfolders in the selected folder. Click a name to view details or navigate into a folder.
user.toolbarDesc: Search, file upload, folder creation, import/export
user.headerDesc: Repository name, language switcher, user menu
user.folderStep1Desc: Located on the right side of the toolbar
user.folderStep3Desc: Select a custom folder type if available
user.folderDelStep3Desc: A cascade delete confirmation is shown if the folder contains files
user.uploadStep1Desc: The blue button in the toolbar
user.uploadStep3Desc: Custom property fields are shown for custom types
user.uploadFormatsMore: images, text, HTML, XML, JSON, and any other file
user.detailIntro: Click a filename in the document list to open the detail screen.
user.btnPermsDesc: Open the permission management page (navigates to a separate page)
user.secondaryDesc: Manage secondary types that add additional metadata to documents. Select a type from the dropdown and click "Add".
user.relationshipDesc: View and manage relationships between documents. Relationships from external ingest (attachments, related records) are also displayed here.
user.verStep2Desc: The document is locked and other users cannot edit it
user.verStep4Desc: Upload the updated file and select major/minor version
user.versionHistoryDesc: View and download past versions from the "Version History" tab in the detail screen.
user.searchStep1: Enter keywords in the search box
user.searchStep1Desc: Search works in both Japanese and English
user.searchStep2: Press Enter or click the "Search" button
user.searchStep3: Click a document in the results
user.searchTipDesc: Not only filenames but also the body text of PDFs, Word documents, and Excel files are searchable. If RAG (semantic search) is enabled, semantically related documents are also displayed.
user.aclIntro: Click the "Permission Management" button in the document detail screen to navigate to the dedicated permission management page.
user.aclAlt: Permission management screen (ACL list with inherited/direct badges)
user.aclAll: Full control (all operations including permission changes and deletion)
user.aclVsAdminDesc: cmis:all is a per-document/folder access permission. A user with cmis:all on a folder can change that folder's permissions. Admin users are system administrators who can manage users/groups and system settings. These are independent concepts.
user.aclStep1: Click the "Permission Management" button in the document detail screen
user.aclStep1Desc: Navigates to the permission management page
user.aclStep3: Select a user or group and set the permission level
user.aclReq: Changing permissions requires cmis:all permission on the target
user.aclInheritDesc: By default, permissions are inherited from the parent folder. Click "Break Inheritance" to switch to custom permissions. When breaking inheritance, the parent's permission entries are copied as direct permissions, which you can then edit individually.
user.cloudPrereqDesc: The Google Drive button appears only when logged in with Google authentication, and the OneDrive button only with Microsoft authentication. These buttons are not shown for password login. Cloud integration must also be enabled on the server.
user.cloudStep1: Click "Import from Google Drive" or "Import from OneDrive"
user.cloudStep1Desc: Provider-specific buttons appear in the toolbar
user.cloudStep2: A file list from your cloud storage is displayed
user.cloudDupeDesc: If you try to import the same file again, an "Import skipped" notification is displayed with an "Open existing document" button to access the original document directly.
user.pkStep4Desc: Authenticate with Touch ID / Face ID / security key
user.passkeyReq: Passkeys are only available in HTTPS environments (or localhost). WebAuthn must be enabled in the server settings.
user.langDesc: Switch between Japanese and English using the language selector in the upper right corner. The setting is saved in the browser and persisted across sessions.

admin.userStep3: Enter user ID, display name, and password
admin.userStep3Desc: Passwords are securely stored using BCrypt hashing. First name, last name, and email can also be set optionally.
admin.userStep4Desc: Configure admin switch, group memberships, and allowed authentication methods (password/passkey/OIDC/SAML).
admin.userPwResetDesc: Click "Reset Password" on a user to set a new password (old password not required).
admin.groupsDesc: Create groups, add/remove members, and set parent-child relationships. Members of child groups automatically inherit the parent group's permissions.
admin.typesIntro: Manage CMIS object type definitions. Create custom types to add custom properties to documents.
admin.typeStep2: Set the type ID and display name
admin.typeStep3Desc: Choose from cmis:document, cmis:folder, cmis:relationship, cmis:policy, cmis:item, cmis:secondary
admin.archRestoreDesc: Restore documents to their original folder (per-row button)
admin.archDownloadDesc: Download the content of archived documents
admin.archForceDesc: Immediately move pending (pre-expiration) documents to the archive
admin.archExtendDesc: Extend the expiration date of pending documents
admin.solrIntro: Monitor and maintain search indexes. Contains Solr (full-text search) and RAG (vector search) sections.
admin.solrStep1Desc: Recreate the search index for all documents (minutes to tens of minutes)
admin.solrFolderReindexDesc: Rebuild the index for documents under a specific folder only. Use the recursive option to include subfolders.
admin.solrClearDesc: Delete all search index data. Rebuild is required afterward.
admin.solrOptimizeDesc: Merge Solr index segments to improve search performance.
admin.solrStep2Desc: Recalculate embeddings for all documents for semantic search. Requires the TEI service and may take a long time depending on document count.
admin.ingestIntro: Automatically ingest documents from external systems. Configure connectors, import profiles, and scheduler management.
admin.ingestConceptConnectorDesc: Defines connection information to an external system. Configure the target URL, authentication token, and archetype (FILE_SHARE / MESSAGE_CONTEXT / CHAT_CONTEXT, etc.). One connector corresponds to one external system.
admin.ingestConceptProfileDesc: Import rules associated with a connector. Configure the destination folder, deduplication policy, versioning strategy, and scheduler enable/disable. Multiple profiles can be created per connector (e.g., multiple Slack channels).
admin.ingestConceptArchetypeDesc: Classifies the type of source data. Five types: FILE_SHARE (files), MESSAGE_CONTEXT (email), COMPOUND_NOTE (notes), CHAT_CONTEXT (chat), BUSINESS_RECORD (business records). Each automatically applies specialized metadata (secondary types).
admin.ingestConceptSchedulerDesc: Polls enabled profiles at configurable intervals (default 5 minutes, configurable via ingest.scheduler.pollIntervalSeconds). Remembers the last ingestion position (checkpoint) and only ingests new items. Fixed interval, not cron.
admin.ingestConceptCircuitBreakerDesc: Connectors that fail consecutively are automatically skipped (default 5 times, configurable via ingest.scheduler.circuitBreakerThreshold). Retries on the next polling cycle (HALF_OPEN), and resets on success.
admin.ingestConceptIdempotencyDesc: Requests with the same idempotencyKey are deduplicated for 7 days (TTL). Expired keys are automatically purged every hour.
admin.ingestExecIdleDesc: IMAP-only real-time monitoring mode. Start via admin API /idle/start/{profileId}. The IMAP IDLE command triggers immediate ingestion when new messages arrive. Automatically reconnects with exponential backoff on connection errors.
admin.ingestConnStep3Desc: A unique identifier (e.g., "slack-workspace-1"). Cannot be changed after creation. Display name is optional.
admin.ingestConnStep4Desc: Select from the dropdown. Supported systems: IMAP / Gmail / M365 Mail / Slack / Microsoft Teams / Mattermost / Chatwork / Notion / Salesforce / Box / Dropbox. Selecting a system auto-sets the archetype.
admin.ingestConnStep5Desc: Select from the dropdown: FILE_SHARE / COMPOUND_NOTE / CHAT_CONTEXT / BUSINESS_RECORD / MESSAGE_CONTEXT. Auto-set when a source system is selected first. Defaults to FILE_SHARE for new connectors.
admin.ingestConnStep6Desc: Select authentication type (authType): oauth2 / api_key / service_account / none. Enter the API URL in the endpoint field. For Microsoft services, also set tenantId. For webhook usage, configure webhookSecret.
admin.ingestConnNoteDesc: Webhook secrets are masked as [configured] in GET responses after saving. To change, enter a new value and save. Saving with an empty value preserves the existing value. Actual API tokens are managed server-side via credentialRef (property reference) and are not displayed in the UI.
admin.ingestProfStep3Desc: A unique identifier (e.g., "slack-general-ch"). Cannot be changed after creation.
admin.ingestProfStep3bDesc: Enter connector IDs in allowedConnectorIds, and set the default connector for scheduler execution in defaultConnectorId.
admin.ingestProfStep4Desc: Set the CMIS folder ID in targetFolderId. If omitted, items are saved to the root folder.
admin.ingestProfStep5Desc: Set deduplication, update, and versioning policies (see below)
admin.ingestProfStep6Desc: Set adapter-specific parameters (channelId, userId, etc.) in schedulerParams as JSON
admin.ingestProfStep7Desc: Turn on schedulerEnabled to start automatic ingestion (default 5-minute intervals). defaultConnectorId is required.
admin.ingestDedupePolicyDesc: skip_if_same_version (default): Skip if a document with the same source identity already exists. create_new_version: Add as a new version to the existing document. replace: Delete existing and create fresh. create_new_if_parent_context_changed: Create new only if the source's parent context has changed. replace_relationships_on_resync: Delete existing relationships and recreate on resync.
admin.ingestUpdatePolicyDesc: always_version_up: Always create a new version (checkout → checkin). update_metadata_only: Update metadata only (no content change). version_up_on_content_change: Version up only if the SHA-256 content hash has changed.
admin.ingestVersionPolicyDesc: major: Major version (1.0 → 2.0). minor: Minor version (1.0 → 1.1). none: No versioning.
admin.ingestDedupeMatchByDesc: source_id (default): Match by source system ID (sourceObjectId + sourceSystem + sourceObjectType). filename: Match by filename (useful for chat attachments with unstable IDs). source_id_or_filename: Try source ID first, fall back to filename.
admin.ingestAclPolicyDesc: inherit_from_folder (default): Inherit parent folder permissions (CMIS standard behavior). none: Break inheritance from parent folder and set independent permissions. copy_from_source: Copy source ACLs as local ACEs in NemakiWare.
admin.ingestPreserveEmlDesc: When enabled, the original .eml file is saved as a separate document linked to the message body via a nemaki:hasAttachment relationship.
admin.ingestClassificationDesc: When set, a nemaki:classificationInfo secondary type is automatically applied to imported documents (e.g., 'confidential', 'internal').
admin.ingestExecScheduledDesc: When schedulerEnabled is on, executes automatically at configurable intervals (default 5 minutes, via ingest.scheduler.pollIntervalSeconds). Only ingests items since the last checkpoint (timestamp or message ID). Uses fixed intervals, not cron. Rate limiting (rateLimitRpm) controls API call frequency. Fetch timeout defaults to 30 minutes (via ingest.scheduler.fetchTimeoutMinutes).
admin.ingestExecManualDesc: Select a profile from the "Manual Import" tab to execute immediately. Works even when the scheduler is disabled. Useful for testing or initial bulk ingestion.
admin.ingestExecWebhookDesc: Supports Slack Events API, Microsoft Graph changeNotification, and generic HMAC webhooks. Set webhookSecret on the connector, and ingestion executes immediately upon event notification from the external system. The Webhook URL is displayed in the Connectors tab.
admin.ingestSchedulerParamsDesc: Set in schedulerParams as JSON format. Required parameters vary by adapter.
admin.ingestJobManagementDesc: A job record is created for each scheduler execution, with progress tracked in real-time.
admin.ingestJobStatusDesc: RUNNING: In progress (monitored via heartbeat). COMPLETED: Successfully finished. PARTIAL: Some succeeded, some failed. FAILED: All items failed. Fetch timeout (default 30 minutes, configurable via ingest.scheduler.fetchTimeoutMinutes) interrupts the thread and marks the job FAILED. Consecutive connector failures trigger the circuit breaker, skipping until the next cycle.
admin.ingestCheckpointDesc: Remembers the last successfully ingested position for each profile. Next execution ingests only from this position. Checkpoints vary by adapter (Gmail: date, Slack: message ts, IMAP: UID, etc.). Checkpoints can be reset via the admin API for full re-ingestion.
admin.ingestContentHashDesc: Calculates and stores SHA-256 hash at ingestion time. With the version_up_on_content_change policy, matching hashes result in metadata-only updates, preventing unnecessary version creation.
admin.ingestDlqIntro: Failed ingest items are processed based on error classification.
admin.ingestDlqTransientDesc: Network timeouts, HTTP 429 (rate limited), HTTP 503 (service unavailable). Saved to DLQ and can be re-ingested via the "Retry" button. No automatic retry.
admin.ingestDlqPermanentDesc: Authentication errors, insufficient permissions, data format errors, etc. Fix the cause before retrying. Original content is preserved as a CouchDB attachment in the DLQ record.
admin.ingestDlqRetryDesc: Check DLQ items for failed jobs in the "Job History" tab, then click "Retry". The appropriate ingestion flow is automatically selected based on the archetype. 60-second cooldown applies.
admin.ingestExStep1Desc: Create a Slack App and obtain a Bot Token (xoxb-...) with channels:history, channels:read, files:read scopes
admin.ingestExStep2Desc: Select source system: slack — the archetype CHAT_CONTEXT is auto-set. Auth type: api_key. The Bot Token is managed via a server-side property.
admin.ingestExStep3Desc: Set defaultConnectorId to the connector ID, schedulerParams: {"channelId":"C01ABCD2345"}, dedupePolicy: skip_if_same_version, targetFolderId: destination folder ID
admin.ingestExStep4Desc: Turn on schedulerEnabled — new messages and attachments from the channel will be automatically ingested at regular intervals (default every 5 minutes)
admin.ingestExStep5Desc: Set webhookSecret and register the Webhook URL shown in the Connectors tab as the Slack Events API Request URL for instant ingestion on message post
admin.ingestRateLimitDesc: Default rate limits are set per adapter (e.g., CHAT_CONTEXT: 3 RPM, FILE_SHARE: 2 RPM). Adjust per connector via the rateLimitRpm parameter. Configure appropriately based on the external API's rate limits.
admin.dlqDesc: Failed ingest items are saved to the DLQ. Check the "Job History" tab, fix the cause, then click "Retry" to re-ingest (60-second cooldown).
admin.auditDesc: View audit event statistics (total events, success/skipped/failed counts and rates) and a filterable event log. Metrics can be reset.
admin.webhookDesc: Send HTTP notifications to external URLs when documents are created, updated, or deleted. Webhook configuration is managed via REST API. This screen shows registered configurations, delivery logs, and allows test sending.
admin.syncDesc: Sync users and groups from Google Workspace / Microsoft Entra ID to NemakiWare. Manual execution is available from "Integration Settings" → "Directory Sync" tab.
admin.syncGoogleDesc: Requires a Google Cloud service account (JSON key file) with domain-wide delegation. Configure admin email and domain name.
admin.syncMicrosoftDesc: Requires an Azure AD app registration with Client Credentials (tenant ID, client ID, client secret).
admin.syncLdapDesc: Sync users and groups from LDAP/LDAPS servers. Configure Bind DN, base DN, and connection URL.
admin.syncScheduleNoteDesc: Scheduled automatic sync is configured via the cloud.directory.sync.cron property in nemakiware.properties (cron expression). UI-based schedule configuration is not currently available.
admin.ieDesc: Bulk import/export of documents via the server's local filesystem. Export outputs JSON metadata + content files to a server directory. Import supports overwrite settings for files with the same name.
admin.configDesc: View current system settings and their source. Search by property key or filter by category.
admin.configNote: The Config Viewer is read-only for most settings. The password policy (minimum length) can be changed directly from this page. Other settings require editing property files or using the admin API.
admin.apiDesc: Open "Admin" → "API Documentation" to view and try REST APIs via Swagger UI.
admin.apiCsrfDesc: REST API POST/PUT/DELETE requests are CSRF-protected. When accessing from CLI or curl, use one of: X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header, Bearer token, AUTH_TOKEN header, or X-API-Key header. These are non-ambient credentials and bypass CSRF checks. Basic auth alone is NOT sufficient — browsers auto-attach it, so X-Requested-With is required alongside Basic auth.
admin.mcpIntro: NemakiWare includes a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. MCP-compatible AI clients like Claude Code can search, retrieve, and semantically search documents. No special configuration is required — it is automatically available when NemakiWare Core is running.
admin.mcpClientsIntro: NemakiWare's MCP server uses Streamable HTTP transport (HTTP POST). Connect from various MCP-compatible AI tools using the steps below.
admin.mcpCdIntro: Claude Desktop only supports stdio transport, so use the mcp-remote proxy to connect to NemakiWare's HTTP MCP server.
admin.mcpCdStep2Desc: Add the configuration below. File location: macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
admin.mcpCdStep3Desc: Fully quit and restart Claude Desktop. If nemakiware tools appear under the tool icon (🔨) in the chat, the connection is successful.
admin.mcpCcStep1Desc: Per project: create .mcp.json in the project root. User-wide: create ~/.claude/mcp.json.
admin.mcpCcStep2Desc: Add the JSON configuration below. Change the URL to match your NemakiWare server.
admin.mcpCcStep3Desc: CLI: use the /mcp command to check connection status. VS Code / JetBrains: reload the extension. If nemakiware_* tools appear in the tool list, the connection is successful.
admin.mcpCursorStep1Desc: Create .cursor/mcp.json in the project root (or use "Settings" → "MCP" tab in Cursor GUI)
admin.mcpCursorStep2Desc: Add the JSON configuration below. Cursor supports HTTP transport, so direct connection is possible.
admin.mcpCursorStep3Desc: Restart Cursor and check "Settings" → "MCP" tab — if nemakiware shows as connected, it's successful
admin.mcpWindsurfStep2Desc: Add the configuration below to mcp_config.json
admin.mcpWindsurfStep3Desc: If nemakiware appears in the Cascade panel tool list, the connection is successful
admin.mcpChatGPTIntro: ChatGPT Desktop supports MCP but only via stdio transport. Use the mcp-remote proxy to connect to NemakiWare's HTTP MCP server.
admin.mcpChatGPTStep1Desc: No pre-installation needed — runs via npx (requires Node.js 18+)
admin.mcpChatGPTStep2Desc: ChatGPT Desktop → "Settings" → "Beta features" → Enable "MCP servers" → Click "Configure"
admin.mcpChatGPTStep3Desc: "+ Add Server" → Name: nemakiware, Command: enter the command value below
admin.mcpGeminiIntro: Google's Gemini CLI supports MCP but only via stdio transport. Like ChatGPT, use the mcp-remote proxy.
admin.mcpGeminiStep1: 1. Open the Gemini CLI settings file
admin.mcpGeminiStep3Desc: Restart the gemini command and check with /tools — if nemakiware tools appear, the connection is successful
admin.mcpOtherDesc: Connect from any MCP-compatible client using the following settings:
admin.mcpStdioNoteDesc: NemakiWare's MCP server is HTTP-based. Clients that only support stdio transport (Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI, etc.) should use the mcp-remote proxy: npx mcp-remote http://localhost:8080/core/mcp/message --header "Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4="
admin.mcpAuthNoteDesc: The Basic auth header value is the Base64-encoded "username:password". Example: admin:admin → YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=. After connecting, you can also use the nemakiware_login tool to obtain a session token and switch to Bearer authentication.
admin.mcpToolsListNoteDesc: By default, the MCP tools list (tools/list) is publicly accessible without authentication. For internet-facing deployments, go to Admin → Integration Settings → MCP tab and turn off 'Tools List Public'. When disabled, tools/list requires authentication.
admin.mcpToolLogin: Log in with username/password and obtain a session token
admin.mcpToolApikey: Log in with an API Key
admin.mcpToolSearch: Search documents using CMIS SQL queries
admin.mcpToolRag: Semantic (RAG) search. Search related documents using natural language
admin.mcpToolSimilar: Search for documents similar to a specified document
admin.mcpToolContent: Get the body text of a document
admin.mcpUsageSearchDesc: Ask Claude Code "Search NemakiWare for quarterly reports" and it will automatically call the nemakiware_search or nemakiware_rag_search tool.
admin.mcpUsageContentDesc: Ask "Summarize the contents of this document" and it will retrieve the text via nemakiware_get_document_content and generate a summary.
admin.mcpUsageSimilarDesc: Ask "Find documents related to this contract" and it will use nemakiware_similar_documents to search for semantically similar documents (when RAG is enabled).
admin.mcpRagNoteDesc: nemakiware_rag_search and nemakiware_similar_documents always appear in the tool list, but executing them when RAG (vector search) is not enabled results in a "Vector search is not enabled" error. When RAG is disabled, use nemakiware_search (CMIS SQL) instead.

lineage.journaledNotice: Journaled mode: events are stored in CouchDB. Projection to external targets (Purview, Atlas, etc.) is not yet active. Set lineage.purge.cron to enable automatic purging.
lineage.backlogMaxRetryCountHelp: Per-target retry limit. Events exceeding this are auto-discarded (dead-lettered). 0 to disable. Default: 5
lineage.backlogMaxRetryAgeHoursHelp: Events older than this with non-terminal targets are auto-discarded. 0 to disable. Default: 72 hours (3 days)
lineage.backlogMaxDocsHelp: When non-terminal events exceed this count, oldest are auto-discarded. 0 to disable. Default: 10000
lineage.backlogMaxSizeMbHelp: When estimated non-terminal event size exceeds this, oldest are auto-discarded. 0 to disable. Default: 100MB
lineage.projectionPollIntervalHelp: How often the projector polls the journal for pending events. Default: 10 seconds
lineage.projectionBatchSizeHelp: Maximum events processed per poll cycle. Default: 50
lineage.projectionStaleThresholdHelp: PROJECTING events older than this are reset to FAILED. Default: 5 minutes
lineage.leaderElectionEnabledHelp: Enable CouchDB CAS-based leader election for multi-node deployments. Leave disabled for single-node.
lineage.leaderHeartbeatSecondsHelp: How often the leader node sends heartbeats. Default: 15 seconds
lineage.leaderTtlSecondsHelp: Time after last heartbeat before leadership expires. Default: 60 seconds

lineage.journalLinkNotice: Journaled mode is active. You can browse and replay events from the Lineage Journal screen.
